│ Choose                                                                       │
│ ▸ ● decode                                                                   │
│       How fast the model writes its answer, one token at a time after        │
│       the prompt. The usual first run, and the one to pick for chat.         │
│                                                                              │
│     prefill                                                                  │
│       How fast the model reads a prompt, at lengths from 512 tokens up       │
│       to the longest it takes. Pick it when long prompts or documents        │
│       matter.                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│     session                                                                  │
│       How speed holds up as a conversation grows: a 512-token turn added     │
│       to 1K tokens already read, then 4 times more, up to what fits in       │
